note: Read-only. The change bounds every partner model/tool call of a sparring pass by its deadline and shortens STALE_AFTER_MS to 20 min (services/gateway/src/services/plan-sparring/). Inducing a hung model call or creating a sparring session on staging would be a write (rule 48), so the behaviour proof is the gateway jest suites below; the HTTP probes prove the deployed build boots with the changed plan-sparring module mounted and its auth gate unchanged. Nothing targets production.

tests.name: gateway alive after deploy
